text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day, huh. Customarily, it's a day
for giving chocolates or bouquets, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A board gamer has
their own way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yes, what I'm giving isn't chocolate, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer, care to play this game with me today, as a special treat?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The name of the game is—
"I give to you the marriage proposal words
I just came up with."

It was that super famous game where you craft
and propose with romantic lines.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day. Allow me to present you with some very special words.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple. Combine cards with words written on them
to create a marriage proposal.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: For example—just like this.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "I want to shatter your darkness and hold you close."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "From a wild filly like me, wings to you."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: How is it?

As expected of Rulership.
She's great at coming up with combinations like this, too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let the game begin. This time, feel free
to give me a "proposal" as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Not done yet, Trainer?
You seem to be giving it quite a lot of thought."

...It was surprisingly difficult once I actually tried.
Even so, somehow...
"From now until forever, I will make you happy—you, who are more precious to me than life itself."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

I couldn't make anything too elaborate.
It's a pretty ordinary message, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No, this is...
No no no... wa... huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I seeee... So that's what you really thought of me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: More important than life itself, huh...

For Rulership to fulfill her dreams in racing and find happiness...
Naturally, as her Trainer, that is my deepest wish.
choice_data_list: I'll keep doing my best from now on!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is troubling. Well, not that I'm actually troubled.
Wait, which is it? Whatever, ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem!* N-Now it's my turn!
I'll enchant you with the most supreme of words!
Um...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Let me put it this way: you are miso soup."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, shoot!
I picked the wrong card, one more time!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "My very own home, hole, and happiness."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no, no, this isn't a proposal,
it's just blurting out my true feelings! Dammit!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: My rhythm is completely thrown off... To think I'd be rattled this much. But still...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"This is the end. With this final play,
I will definitely blow you away."

Rulership puts her brain into overdrive,
pondering combinations.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Listen to me—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: “‘I'll show you a miracle, Grandpa, with your own eyes.’”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wh-What are you saying??? At this point it's just a magic trick, and it's ridiculously impressive for no reason~~~!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, no, no, no. That's it for today, no more.
It's all because you had to go and say something weird, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I lost, I lost. But playing with you
was my present to you, so...
Though Rulership sulked, the game had been a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Destiny surely exists—and you're mine alone."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this is...
What do you think, Trainer?

"Destiny... does exist.
From those words spoken by Rulership..."
choice_data_list: Such strong feelings... I can feel them...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I see. Did it strike a chord with you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whew, looks like a move of divine inspiration
was unleashed at the eleventh hour.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is a Valentine's gift from me.
Let us walk alongside fate together, Trainer.

True to her word, Rulership gave herself
the greatest gift of all.

—After school that day.
While adjusting the training menu...

Rulership wasn't the only one
who gave a special message
for Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm, who's it from?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't tell me it's another Umamusume?
Curse that third faction...!
It wasn't addressed just to me, but to Rulership and myself. This email was—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What... Dubai!?
Then...

Every year in March, Dubai holds a special day
where numerous international GⅠ races take place
at the same time.
And astonishingly, Rulership was invited to one of those very races.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, hahaha, I hear it, I hear it.
The sound of the unopened door unlocking.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is it! This is the breakthrough
I've been looking for!!
The key to having all mankind acknowledge me as their ruler!
Dubai's international GⅠ. Its prestige and global recognition far surpass domestic GⅠs.
"If he puts on a run there that overwhelms the world, everyone will acknowledge Rulership as a true ruler."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"What kind of gamer would let a golden opportunity
that fell right into their lap slip away?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I accept, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I will accept this invitation, even if it means throwing everything else away!
Let us march forth with heads held high!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To make our domination absolute,
—to the world stage!
Rulership wasn't the only one who received an invitation.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Is this... an invitation?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much.
This year, for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe I'll just give it everything I've got and see how it goes~.

Prominent Japanese Umamusume were also invited,
and most of them accepted.

The exceptional love letter received on Valentine's Day
set everyone's hearts ablaze.
